definition.def: The distribution of things involves giving or delivering them to a number of people or places.
examples: ...the council which controls the distribution of foreign aid. [+ of]
He admitted there had been distribution problems.

definition.def: The distribution of something is how much of it there is in each place or at each time, or how much of it each person has.
examples: ...a more equitable distribution of wealth. [+ of]
...the geographical distribution of parasitic diseases such as malaria.

definition.def: Film distribution involves deciding which cinemas a particular film is shown in.
